raw.details:
Anveshan is organising Not another “make a PPT and call it innovation” hackathon.

Forged in Fire 2026 is all about building stuff that actually works — hosted at BPIT, Delhi.

Online Round: 21 October 2026

Offline Finale: 24 October 2026

Prize Pool: ₹10,000

Venue: BPIT, Delhi

How It Works:

Round 1 — Online:

Fill out the Google Form provided for Round 1.

Round 1 and Round 2 will end together.

Round 2 — Online:

Don't have a fully polished product? Who cares.

Just show us:
Your technical architecture
A working demo/prototype


What you're building + why it actually matters

If your tech is solid and your demo works, you're through to the offline round.
No unnecessary 50-slide pitch deck energy.

Offline Finale:

Qualified? Now you're in the fire.


Come to BPIT on 24 October, build further, break things, fix them, and ship your final solution.
And yes — every team that qualifies gets a FREE n8n account to use during the offline round.

Pick Your Battle:

n8n Sponsored Track:

Automate everything.
Build crazy-good workflows using n8n — AI automation, agentic workflows, integrations, data pipelines, autonomous processes, whatever you can cook up.
If it involves AI + automation + workflows, you're probably cooking.

Agentic Track:

Chatbots are cool. Agents are cooler.
Build systems that can actually think → plan → use tools → take action.
Multi-agent systems, coding agents, research agents, AI assistants, agent orchestration, autonomous systems — go wild.

Open Innovation:

No box. No predefined problem.
Got an idea that doesn't fit the other tracks?
Build it.
FinTech, Cybersecurity, Web3, EdTech, HealthTech, AI, DevTools, Sustainability, IoT — whatever problem you wanna solve.
If it's innovative and actually works, we wanna see it.

Team Rules:

Inter-college teams? YES.
Different branches/specializations? YES.
Mix your skills. Build together.
Pick one track for your project.
Your project should be your team's work.
Open-source tools, APIs, frameworks, etc. are allowed.
Don't pull a Ctrl+C → Ctrl+V on someone else's project. Plagiarism = instant L.
Online round requires a working demo + technical architecture.
Qualifying teams must attend the offline finale at BPIT.
Judges will evaluate tech, architecture, innovation, execution, impact & demo.
Judges' decision is final.

What's in It for You?:

₹10,000 Prize Pool
Goodies for participants + winners
FREE FOOD during the offline round
FREE n8n account for every team that qualifies
Build with other cracked builders

TL;DR:

21 OCT → Fill Round 1 form + Build + Show us your tech online.

You qualify → FREE n8n account

24 OCT → Pull up to BPIT

Build. Break. Fix. Ship.

WIN ₹10,000 + goodies + bragging rights.

Don't overthink it:

You don't need a perfect product.

You just need something that works, has a solid technical backbone, and makes us go:

“Okay… these guys are cooking.”
